cases.title: Signed message from a registered Acme address
cases.explanation: billing@acme.example is listed for Acme in the registry and the signature is valid. Agrees with the ground truth.

cases.title: Reply-To on the same domain
cases.explanation: Replies go to another Acme address, which is normal. Agrees with the ground truth.

cases.title: Signed with a second selector
cases.explanation: Acme publishes selectors s1 and s2; this message uses s2, which is current. Agrees with the ground truth.

cases.title: Published key record is malformed

cases.explanation: The message carries “Authentication-Results: dkim=pass” that the sender typed (invariant 3). Missed: the engine abstained, which counts against recall.

cases.explanation: A valid message from Alice at an unregistered company; the name matches the registry but the address does not. Ground truth is set when a fixture is created and does not depend on the engine output.
